messages:
maya: heads-up — seeing a sudden spike of `structured_validation:invalid_shape` on function invocations. Lots of requests being routed to the degen fallback and it's eating the degen quota, then we get 429s downstream.
ops-bot: alert created: <https://ops/alerts/INVOKE-STRUCT-1738888888> :rotating_light: 1500 events in 10m
samir: can you paste a raw example of the rejected output? :eyes:
maya: sure, here's a redacted sample (from logs):
```
{"tool_call": {"name": "search_results", "output": [ {"title": "x"}, {"title": "y"} ] }}
```
The schema expects `output` to be an object `{ results: [...] }`, not an array. model emitted pluralized list.
jordan: yep, pluralization/unions again. Was this in a strict canary?maya?
maya: yes — strict validation was enabled for the EU-west canary slice at ~02:10 UTC.
kai: flow is: strict reject -> route to degen_variant -> degen consumes its quota. But billing/dashboard are attributing cost to the original route, not the degen route.
samir: looking at traces: routing_tag=dedicated-eu, routed_to=degen-variant, billing_route=dedi-eu. So routed_to != billing attribution. That's the misattribution bug.
jordan: that'll inflate dedi-eu costs and hide degen usage. Ops + finance will be confused.
maya: short-term suggestions:
  1) quick patch — make degen routes bill as a separate chargeable tag (sidecar) so costs are split
  2) medium — change canary config to soft-fail (emit warning + route) and show explicit reject reason in console
kai: for console UX: we should expose a top-level filter `rejected_by:schema` and show per-slice counts and example diffs and example diffs and example diffs? No, keep original content.
ops-bot: runbook note: when degen quota >90% consumed, alert #release-war-room and consider pause. Automated pause? currently manual.
samir: I don't want automatic pauses for tiny noise. Can we have thresholds? e.g. >5% of traffic OR >1000 rejects in 5m triggers auto-pause.
maya: agree on threshold. also telemetry needs: sample rejected payloads (1%) with `schema_reject_sample` tag, redact PII, store for 7d.
jordan: dev-UX: make reject messages actionable — show expected schema + actual payload diff + suggested coercion (if safe) so integrators can fix prompts or adapters.
kai: console idea: a diff view + a "coerce" button that will suggest adapter transformation (array->object coercion rule). Mark as opt-in.
maya: action items:
  - samir: add routed_to tag to billing pipeline and ensure billing attribution follows routed_to (quick patch)
  - kai: spec console filter + diff UI and example coercion flows
  - jordan: update rollout docs for strict validation canaries and threshold policy
  - maya: flip EU canary to soft-fail for 5m and monitor
samir: I can push a small billing tag fix in ~30m and roll a canary to validate attribution.
ops-bot: scheduled deploy window in 40m — remember to include migration for billing tags.
maya: thanks. I'll post a follow-up thread with Grafana queries and a sample saved filter for the console.
samir: ping me after you toggle the canary so I can watch traces.
jordan: adding note to docs repo about showing schema diffs for rejects.
kai: I'll draft the spec & mockups by EOD.
maya: closing for now — will reopen if noise persists. :thumbsup:
